regime.summary: Policy rate held at 11.5% while CPI jumped from 7.29% to 11.08% in three months, so the real rate is about zero and bills sit above the policy rate: some hike risk. Offsetting: Brent down 46% and the last hold type has positive odds. Index is +26% in 3 months, foreign corporates sold. Neutral, trim from default, no cash dogma.

exposure_reason: Below the 75% default by 15 points, not cash: the index is +26.2% in 3 months, CPI rose 3.8pp to 11.08% against a policy rate of 11.5%, and bills sit above the policy rate, which is the early shape of the tightening-with-CPI lesson. The hold-base rate and falling Brent keep me from cutting further; the three core names are screen-based, so I size them below full.
